title: AdamMeme: Adaptively Probe the Reasoning Capacity of Multimodal Large Language Models on Harmfulness
findings: The models exhibited varied performance in identifying harmful religious content in memes. GPT-4o and the Step series models demonstrated the strongest performance. The iterative refinement process effectively exposed model-specific weaknesses; for instance, Doubao-Lite was particularly challenged by refined memes concerning religion, showing a significant drop in failure rate when the refinement stage was removed.
